headline: X replaces its revenue-sharing program with ‘Original Content Rewards’
summary: X is launching a new 'Original Content Rewards' program. It replaces the old, controversial revenue-sharing scheme. Creators need 500+ verified followers and 500k+ impressions to qualify.

headline: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
summary: Amazon's new West Texas data center will be powered by a highly polluting plant. This gas-burning facility could become one of the US's worst greenhouse gas emitters. Amazon has made significant investments in its construction.

headline: Buc-ee’s dodges John Oliver to sue another small business
summary: Buc-ee's bypassed John Oliver's direct challenge to sue them. Oliver used a squirrel mascot to provoke a lawsuit. The company instead sued another small business, continuing a controversial pattern.

headline: Musician and entrepreneur Tom Vek is building a digital music player, but don’t call it retro
summary: Musician Tom Vek is creating a new digital music player. He insists his device is not 'retro' despite the format's history. Vek gained fame in 2005 with his unique indie-electronica sound.

headline: Mortal Kombat Director 'Not Sure' About Return for Third Movie as Mortal Kombat 3 Remains in Limbo
summary: Mortal Kombat movie director Simon McQuoid is unsure if he will return for a third film. Production on 'Mortal Kombat 3' remains in limbo. This puts the future of the movie franchise in doubt.

headline: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Opening Permanent Location Featuring Animatronic Stage Shows in 2027
summary: Freddy Fazbear's Pizza will open a permanent location in 2027. The restaurant will feature animatronic stage shows, bringing the game to life. This project is a collaboration with entertainment center American Dream.

headline: 'They Fundamentally Don't Understand Art' — Doom Dev Blasts Xbox After Microsoft 'Gutted' id Software With Layoffs
summary: A 'Doom' developer slammed Xbox following layoffs at id Software. Lead programmer Chris Hays accused Xbox of not understanding art. Microsoft's cutbacks at id Software in July prompted the strong criticism.

summary: Discover the top deals available today on various products. Find significant discounts on AirPods Pro 3. Score deals on popular items like LEGO Back to the Future sets.

headline: Andy Burnham to embark on cost of living tour through the UK
summary: Andy Burnham will tour the UK to highlight the cost of living crisis. Downing Street says the PM's plans offer 'room to breathe'. Opposition critics accuse the government of 'hypocrisy'.

headline: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
summary: Fifa condemned a 'concerted and ongoing effort' to undermine its president, Gianni Infantino. The football body criticized campaigns seeking to oust him. Fifa maintains strong support for its leadership amidst controversy.

headline: Killed a month after his wedding - why PC Andrew Harper's death touched so many
summary: PC Andrew Harper was killed tragically just a month after his wedding. His death continues to deeply resonate with the public. The early release of two killers has brought the case back into the spotlight.

headline: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
summary: Israel faces accusations of using archaeology as a political tool in the West Bank. The nation plans large-scale land expropriations in historic Palestinian areas. Critics suggest archaeological projects serve to bolster land claims.
